== Summary ==
PC Errata 2016 disc card image of [[Blaster Rifle (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]]: PC Errata 2016 disc card (Players Committee card image with a bronze disc mark, starwarsccg.org card lists).

Source: Players Committee card image [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/blasterrifle.gif blasterrifle.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160324153130/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/blasterrifle.gif Internet Archive] (24 March 2016, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 17 February 2025: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250217165329/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/blasterrifle.gif Internet Archive].

Uploaded unchanged (SHA-1 <code>9ee32754f7e5b4ed26b442fe07b9c44085685969</code>).

Fair use rationale: a low-resolution image of a Star Wars CCG card or errata slip (© Decipher Inc. / Players Committee, Star Wars © Lucasfilm Ltd.), used only to identify and study the card's errata on this non-commercial fan wiki; no free equivalent exists.
